All — reviewed NovaCorp's redlines and sketched our changes in the attached doc. High-level summary:

- Pilot cap: acceptable as a temporary credit cap for the first 90 days; we recommended a per-month cap expressed in USD (see §4.2 in attached) to avoid token accounting mismatch.
- Ops gating: converted NovaCorp's soft gating language into a short acceptance criteria table (integration checklist + perf thresholds + sign-off owners). That table sits in Exhibit B of the SOW and references the playbook.
- Billing/proration: proposed pro-rata invoice for partial-month delivery and a late acceptance trigger (30 days after completion if no sign-off).
- Liability/indemnity edits: left core MSA indemnities intact but softened a couple of aggressive caps NovaCorp requested — noted them in the margin for commercial review.

I marked anything that requires commercial tradeoff as "COMM-DECISION" in comments. Jordan — please weigh in on cap level and revenue impact. Connor — confirm the checklist items are operationally feasible for your team and NovaCorp.

If NovaCorp Legal wants to walk through our rationale, happy to schedule a 30-minute call next week. Otherwise we can exchange one more redline round and move to signature routing.

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Contracts

If possible, we'd like to get to a mutually-executable draft by EOD Wed (9/29). Can Redwood confirm?

Best,
